evidence.observation: Pressure 3.02 Torr at growth start, matching the ~3.0 Torr held through the ramp at Ar 100 sccm.
Pressure rose steadily to 3.51 Torr (+16%) while Ar setpoint and flow stayed at ~100 sccm.
MFC reads 100.4 sccm, so more inflow does not explain the pressure rise.
Thermocouple steady at 750.0 °C with heater power ~45%, so the thermal loop looks normal.
O2 exhaust sensor not installed, so I cannot check for air getting in.

args.missing_evidence: To tell a blocked exhaust from a seal leak: do a rate-of-rise test (isolate the pump or close the Ar inlet and watch pressure), check the exhaust line and pump throttle, or add an O2/residual-gas reading.
